violated_contract: Fresh recurring checkout must not create a second subscription when a stored Stripe subscription is still nonterminal or its state cannot be verified, even if local entitlement projection says Free or the root customer ID is missing.
canonical_prevention: Keep fresh-checkout admission at the existing reactivation boundary. Verify the raw stored recurring-subscription ID before creating a session; only confirmed terminal or definitively missing subscriptions can fall through. Preserve same-plan reactivation, block other nonterminal states, and fail closed on provider or persistence errors. One-time grants are not recurring subscriptions.
